compute_nat_loss: compute the non-autoregressive translation loss for model outputs against targets with optional label smoothing
review_reduce_metrics: review the reduce_metrics method that aggregates logging outputs and computes perplexity from data parallel training
refactor_compute_loss: refactor the _compute_loss method to support additional loss types beyond NLL and KL divergence
test_forward_criterion: test the forward method of LabelSmoothedDualImitationCriterion with a sample batch and model outputs
summarize_add_args: summarize the add_args method that registers the label-smoothing argument for the NAT loss criterion
